summary: In this excerpt from a fiction story titled 'Book 4 — part 43', Anda watches photos of exploited little girls working at PCs and a poor shantytown, shown by Raymond, who is in a game. Lucy wants to kill Raymond, but Anda protects him and argues he deserves a hearing. Raymond argues that gold farmers who sell in-game gold for cash must play to eat, and Lucy and Anda end up fighting each other in the game, with Anda winning the duel as Lucy runs away.
one_line: In a virtual game world, Anda defends Raymond from Lucy's anger over photos of exploited children working in gold-farming operations.
key_facts: Raymond shows photos of about fifty or more ranked little girls in clean t-shirts sitting at generic white-box PCs with hands on the keyboards.
The photos show a shantytown of corrugated aluminum shacks, muddy trails, spraypainted graffiti, and rude boys loitering.
A third photo shows three little girls and a little boy on a battered sofa while their mother serves something white and indistinct on plastic plates.
Lucy says she killed Raymond last time and vows to do it again if he tries to show her photos.
Anda interposes her avatar between Lucy's and Raymond's and says, 'Don't do it. He deserves to have a say.'
Raymond types that the workers are wrecking the game economy by providing a gold-for-cash supply that lets rich assholes buy their way in.
Raymond argues that if the workers don't play the game, they don't eat, so they care about the game as much as Lucy does.
Raymond tells Lucy that she is being paid cash to kill these workers and so she needs to play for her money too.
Anda's character clobbers Lucy barehanded, so that Lucy's avatar reels and drops its bow.
Lucy calls Anda 'BITCH' after being struck and draws her sword.
Anda tells Lucy, 'I don't want you to hurt him. I want to hear him out.'
The voicelink drops when Lucy's avatar charges at Anda.
Lucy has more experience points than Anda, but Anda is the better player and knows it.
Anda drives Lucy back down the road they had marched together until Lucy breaks and runs.
